description: Value matrix (src/multilingual/value-matrix.ts): every failing (cell, lane) pair, per cell. A cell is `<position>|<expression>`; a lane is `en` (hyperfixi English), `en-rt` (semantic English round trip, on upstream), `<lang>` (hyperfixi direct path) or `<lang>/up` (the adapter, on upstream); `*direct` and `*up` stand for all 23 of each. Shrink-only: regenerate with tools/regen-value-matrix-baseline.ts.

increment|#a.textContent.accepted: ambiguity: it `di` is both `by` and `of`, so `incrementare i di #a.textContent` also says `increment i of #a.textContent`

increment|#a.textContent + 2.accepted: ambiguity: it `di` is both `by` and `of`, so `incrementare i di #a.textContent` also says `increment i of #a.textContent`

put|the textContent of #a as Int.accepted: known difference: core converts the property, upstream the target (core/docs/UPSTREAM-KNOWN-DIFFS.md)

set|the textContent of #a as Int.accepted: known difference: core converts the property, upstream the target (core/docs/UPSTREAM-KNOWN-DIFFS.md)

while|the textContent of #a as Int.accepted: known difference: core converts the property, upstream the target (core/docs/UPSTREAM-KNOWN-DIFFS.md)

increment|the textContent of #a as Int.accepted: known difference: core converts the property, upstream the target (core/docs/UPSTREAM-KNOWN-DIFFS.md)

increment|#a.textContent as Int.accepted: ambiguity: it `di` is both `by` and `of`, so `incrementare i di #a.textContent` also says `increment i of #a.textContent`
